headline: THE VAULT opens without a death — perfect play pays
lede: Lode Runner-LITE's hardest vault spent a life even under its own proven route — the attract screen taught players to die. The far gold now hangs at the rope's end, so the witness crosses over the guard's head and clears all three vaults with lives intact.

notes.text: #2550: THE VAULT's zero-death witness — collect all five nuggets on the rope (the one highway guards can never enter), ride home over the frozen guard, take the hidden ladder lives 3/3. Vaults 1 and 2 untouched, determinism unchanged.

lodecheck gains a shelf-wide CLEAN-WITNESS gate (no attract demo may spend a life) plus a design-law pin (THE VAULT keeps exactly one walk-row nugget). Mutant proof: guard back at x15 kills both — 136/136 plain, 164/164 --mutate, lodeplay 52/52 live.
Fixed the harness trap that reports success through a pipe: `$?` after `cmd | tail` is TAIL's exit — a lint gate 'passed' misleadingly until re-run unpiped.

look.text: Run THE VAULT and watch the attract demo cross the guard on the rope
